usageNotes: Returns the directory index of firewall sub-resources available for a specific QEMU VM (rules, ipset, aliases, options, refs, log). Use this as a discovery call to confirm which firewall endpoints are reachable before navigating to a specific sub-resource. No special privilege is required beyond being an authenticated user.

examples.summary: List firewall sub-resources for VM 101 on node pve1

tips: This is a pure directory index — it does not return actual firewall rules or settings; follow up with sub-resource endpoints (e.g., get_nodes_node_qemu_vmid_firewall_rules) for actionable data.
The response links use a relative {name} href pattern, meaning each object's 'name' field is the sub-path segment to append.
VM-level firewall settings are independent of the node-level firewall; both must be enabled for VM firewall rules to take effect.
